statement: Nvidia and AMD are lobbying the administration and Congress to drop or narrow China-related chip export provisions in the FY2027 defense authorization bill, targeting AI OVERWATCH Act language and seeking softer Chip Security Act terms rather than a broad rollback.
why: Whether the restrictions are codified sets how much Chinese accelerator demand Nvidia and AMD may legally serve and how much compliance/tracking burden ships with each part; the outcome is still open.

impact.mechanism: Statutory export limits and end-use tracking mandates define the legally addressable China market for advanced accelerators and the design/compliance cost of serving it.

evidence.excerpt: Nvidia and AMD are lobbying the Trump administration to pressure Congress into dropping China-related chip export restrictions from the National Defense Authorization Act (fiscal 2027).

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet relaying Politico reporting; no filing, and the legislative outcome is unresolved.
